_note: Container image + boot entrypoints. Sources: apps/api/Dockerfile.api:1-58; apps/api/bin/docker-entrypoint-{api,api-local,migrator,worker,worker-local,beat,beat-local}.sh (7 files).
bugs: Quirk: GUNICORN_WORKERS has NO in-script default (api.sh:38 passes -w "$GUNICORN_WORKERS" bare) — unset env yields an empty -w arg. Effective defaults live OUTSIDE the script: .env.example=2, deployments/*/variables.env + community docker-compose=1. PORT the bare expansion.
Quirk: api.sh:7-8 carry a stale '# Create the default bucket' comment and a second '#!/bin/bash' line mid-file — PORT as-is (comments only).

dockerfile.pip_install: pip install -r requirements.txt --compile --no-cache-dir (:35), then apk del .build-deps + rm -rf /var/cache/apk/* (:37-39)
setup: RUN apk --no-cache add bash~=5.2 (:48, re-added post-build)

boot_order: machine signature: HOSTNAME=$(hostname); MAC from 'ip link show | awk /ether/ | head -n 1'; CPU_INFO=$(cat /proc/cpuinfo); MEMORY_INFO=$(free -h); DISK_INFO=$(df -h); SIGNATURE=$(echo "$HOSTNAME$MAC_ADDRESS$CPU_INFO$MEMORY_INFO$DISK_INFO" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); export MACHINE_SIGNATURE=$SIGNATURE (:11-21)
exec uvicorn pi_dash.asgi:application --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload (:38 — uvicorn directly so local speaks ASGI like prod, :34-36)
celery -A pi_dash beat -l info (:8 — NO exec, unlike worker)
exec watchmedo auto-restart --directory=./pi_dash --pattern='*.py' --recursive -- celery -A pi_dash beat -l info (:7-11)

migrator.note: $1 is the app/database positional forwarded to BOTH commands

boot_order: concurrency resolution (:19-28): CELERY_WORKER_CONCURRENCY when set, else min(nproc, 8) with '|| echo 8' fallback when nproc missing
exec celery -A pi_dash worker -l info --concurrency "$concurrency" (:33 — exec so celery is PID 1)

env_consumed.CELERY_WORKER_CONCURRENCY: default min(nproc,8) — a ceiling, never a floor (:15-18)

boot_order: exec watchmedo auto-restart --directory=./pi_dash --pattern='*.py' --recursive -- celery -A pi_dash worker -l info (:7-11)
